programme.title: Airgunner Challenge
programme.desc: The competitors are split up into 2 teams of 4 this week. Using the Air Force Texan in 4 styles and 4 calibers, it's time to play a friendly game of H.O.R.S.E. but again with the airgun challenge twist. In this game of "A.I.R.", the rules are similar in that the leading team gets to decide the shot. After deciding the target, shooting position and gun of choice, If all four members hit their shot and the next team does not, then that team gets a letter. It's Big Bores and Long Range in this exciting competition.
